build_Network_NAS_cellular_architecture: build a Network module with supernet matrices to create a NAS-based cellular CNN for image classification
create_MixedOp_multi_operation_layer: create a MixedOp module that sums outputs from multiple candidate operations on the same input tensor
create_Cell_NAS_building_block: create a Cell module with preprocess layers and MixedOp operations for normal or reduction steps in NAS
create_AuxiliaryHeadCIFAR_auxiliary_clas: create an AuxiliaryHeadCIFAR module for auxiliary classification on 8x8 feature maps during CIFAR training
run_drop_path_regularization: run the drop_path function to apply stochastic path dropout regularization to a 4D tensor during training
